items.title_zh: Midnight 发布 Q4 2026–Q1 2027 路线图
items.summary_zh: 路线图覆盖机构发行、隐私 DeFi、身份、扩展与开发者支持等方向；NIGHT 质押与 Cardano SPO 参与区块生产被列为后续计划。
items.summary_en: The roadmap covers institutional issuance, private DeFi, identity, scale and developer support; NIGHT staking and Cardano SPO participation are listed as future work.

items.title_zh: Midnight 主网开启无需预审的智能合约部署
items.title_en: Midnight mainnet opens permissionless smart-contract deployment
items.summary_zh: 开发者可直接向主网部署合约，不再必须先通过 Preprod 的安全审查。该变化仍需以官方公告与后续技术文档为准。
items.summary_en: Developers can deploy contracts directly to mainnet without a mandatory Preprod security review. Check the official announcement and technical docs for scope.

items.title_zh: CPI 数据冲击下 ADA 与 NIGHT 回落，生态路线仍在推进
items.title_en: ADA and NIGHT retreat on CPI shock while ecosystem work continues
items.summary_zh: 媒体报道 ADA 与 NIGHT 在通胀数据公布后下跌，同时提到 Open Wallet Standard、Open Food Chain 与 Midnight 路线图。价格数据属于媒体报道，不是官方确认。
items.summary_en: The report links ADA and NIGHT weakness to inflation data while noting wallet, food-chain and Midnight roadmap developments. Price claims are reported, not official confirmation.

items.title_zh: 日本交易所 OKJ 宣布上线 Midnight（NIGHT）
items.title_en: Japanese exchange OKJ announces Midnight (NIGHT) listing
items.summary_zh: 交易所公告称将于 10 月 13 日开始提供 NIGHT 交易服务；上线范围、地区限制与风险说明应以交易所原公告为准。
items.summary_en: The exchange announcement says NIGHT trading will begin on October 13; availability, regional restrictions and risk disclosures are defined by the exchange.

items.title_zh: 分析：路线图把 NIGHT 质押放在 2027 年第一季度
items.title_en: Analysis: roadmap places NIGHT staking in Q1 2027
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇社区/媒体解读，引用 Midnight 路线图讨论 NIGHT 质押与 Cardano SPO 参与；“计划”不代表已上线。
items.summary_en: A community analysis interprets the Midnight roadmap around NIGHT staking and Cardano SPO participation; a plan is not a launch.

items.title_zh: Cardano 周报聚焦大额 ADA 转账与生态活动
items.title_en: Cardano weekly digest focuses on large ADA transfers and ecosystem activity
items.summary_zh: 周报汇总链上大额转账与生态动态；链上活动本身不等于价格方向或投资结论。
items.summary_en: The digest summarizes large on-chain transfers and ecosystem activity; activity alone is not a price signal or investment conclusion.

items.title_zh: NIGHT 价格波动被报道为主网权限变化后的延续反应
items.title_en: NIGHT move reported as follow-through after mainnet permission change
items.summary_zh: CoinMarketCap 的 AI 文章将价格波动与主网开放部署联系起来；这是二次分析，读者应回看原始公告。
items.summary_en: A CoinMarketCap AI article connects the move to mainnet deployment changes; it is secondary analysis, so readers should check the primary announcement.

items.title_zh: 周报解读 Cardano 治理、Fireblocks 与 Midnight 动态
items.title_en: Weekly analysis covers Cardano governance, Fireblocks and Midnight
items.summary_zh: 社区周报将多项治理、机构托管和 Midnight 事件放在同一时间线；其中部分内容仍应逐条核对原始来源。
items.summary_en: A community weekly report places governance, institutional custody and Midnight events on one timeline; individual claims should be checked against primary sources.
